crash.title: This section could not be displayed
crash.text: An error occurred while drawing it. The rest of the app keeps working; if it happens again, reload the page.

app.noLogin: Checkpoint has no username or password: it can only be opened from this computer (127.0.0.1).

allOff.title: All games are disabled
allOff.text: None is synced. Enable them in Settings.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.help: Game disabled: it is not synced. Enable it in Settings.

sync.title: Sync

solo.label: Checkpoint only
solo.help: Single device: the hub keeps versions; there is no copy between machines.

none.title: No runs yet
none.text: This game has not been synced yet.

noGames.title: No games configured
noGames.text: Add a game in Settings to sync its saved games between devices.

sync.flagText: two different versions, nothing has been saved.

httpConflict.text: the data on the hub and on {device} have both changed.
httpConflict.confirmHub: {device} will download the hub's data and replace its own; its plugin first keeps a copy in the .checkpoint-backup folder next to the game's.
httpConflict.confirmDevice: The hub will keep {device}'s data. It first saves a version of what it has now (you'll see it under Versions).
httpConflict.confirmWhen: Nothing changes now: {device} will apply it when the game opens or closes, or when you press Sync in its plugin.
httpConflict.pendingHub: {device} will use the hub's data on its next sync.
httpConflict.pendingDevice: {device} will upload its data on its next sync.

conflict.title: Conflict in {game}
conflict.note: Nothing has been modified. Before overwriting, the losing copy is saved in versions.

reason.both_changed: Both sides have changed since the last sync and their contents differ.
reason.no_baseline: This is the first comparison with this data and the contents differ.
reason.inconsistent: The contents differ and no changes are recorded.
reason.indeterminate: The dates differ by less than 2 seconds: it is impossible to tell which is newer. Choose manually.
reason.stale: The data has changed since the previous notice was shown. Review and choose again.

versions.disabledNote: Game disabled: restoring only copies to the hub and is not propagated to the devices while it stays disabled.
versions.title: Versions
versions.confirm: Restore {version}/{source} to the hub? The current hub copy is saved as a version.

noGames.text: Once you add a game and it syncs, its saved versions will appear here.

none.title: No saved versions
none.text: There are no versions of this game yet. They are saved automatically when a copy is overwritten during sync.

current.title: Current
current.label: Current
current.help: What the hub holds for this game right now. It cannot be restored: it is already the current one.

orphans.one: There is {count} item of data without a device or game in the hub (for example, from a deleted device).
orphans.other: There are {count} items of data without a device or game in the hub (for example, from a deleted device).

orphans.title: Data without an assigned device
orphans.intro: This data is still in the hub, but it no longer belongs to any device or game in the configuration (for example, from a device or game that was deleted). Nothing is deleted automatically: you can move it to the trash, where it is kept for {days} days before it is deleted for good and from where you can restore it.
orphans.onlyCopy: Only copy: the hub holds the only copy of this game's saves. If you move it to the trash, it will be deleted for good after {days} days.

confirmIntro.one: {count} item will be moved to the trash ({size}):
confirmIntro.other: {count} items will be moved to the trash ({size} in total):

orphans.confirmKeep: The trash keeps them for {days} days and then deletes them for good. Until then you can restore them from here.
orphans.confirmOnlyCopy: Some of them are the only copy of that data.
orphans.ack: I understand that after {days} days what I move is deleted for good
orphans.ackOnlyCopy: I understand that some of it is the only copy and will be deleted for good after {days} days
orphans.trashIntro: It empties itself: each item is deleted for good {days} days after it was moved.
orphans.relocateIntro: The data of "{game}" will be added to the history of another game in the configuration.
orphans.relocateKeep: "{target}" keeps its current saves: what "{game}" has (its versions and its current saves) is only added as versions of its history and nothing is overwritten. If a version has the same date as one already in the target, it arrives with a suffix. The rest (state, logs, etc.) goes to the trash, kept for {days} days.

relocated.one: Relocated to "{target}": {count} version added to its history
relocated.other: Relocated to "{target}": {count} versions added to its history

settings.title: Settings
settings.invalid: config.yaml is not valid: {cause}. Fix it by hand or restore an earlier copy.

stale.text: Saving is disabled so those changes are not overwritten.

noDevices.title: No devices
noDevices.text: Add at least one device to checkpoint your saves (with two, they also sync between them).

settings.needOne: Define (and name) at least one device to add games.
settings.delDevice:
The device {device} is used by: {games}.
Those games will lose this device and you will need to choose another. Delete it?

errorsAria.one: {count} error to fix: go to the first
errorsAria.other: {count} errors to fix: go to the first

game.name: Name
game.soloHint: With a single device, the hub keeps versions; there is no copy between machines.
game.enabledHelp: Disabled: it is not synced (not automatically, manually, nor by the open or close notice). Versions are kept.
game.processHint: Not copied while it is running
game.onConflictHint: Overrides the global Automatic sync setting for this game only.

launcher.disabledNote: Disabled: the notice will be skipped.
launcher.title: Launchers
launcher.noGames: Add a game to get its commands.
launcher.hint: One block per saved game, with the commands for the launcher to notify the hub before the game starts. Pick your launcher and copy the one for each game. The hub watches for the close on its own: no close hook needed.
launcher.saveFirst: Save the game to get its commands.
launcher.noDevices: Choose the game's devices to get its commands.
launcher.noKey: Generate the API key in your profile first.
launcher.noProcess: No process: the hub will not be able to watch for the close (the open notice will still work).
launcher.hubUrlHint: Address the launcher uses to reach the hub. Defaults to this page's; remembered in this browser.
launcher.invalidUrl: Invalid URL: use http:// or https://, with no spaces or quotes.

where.steam: Paste it in the game's Properties → Launch Options (a single line).
where.lutris: Paste it in Configure → System options → Pre-launch script. Turn on “Wait for pre-launch completion”.
where.heroic: Paste it in the game's settings → Advanced → script to run before launch.
where.windows: Paste it in Playnite → Edit game → Scripts → pre-start script (PowerShell 5.1).

launcher.closeNote: The hub watches for the close on its own.

device.localHelp: This is the computer where Checkpoint runs: its folders are accessed directly, without SSH.
device.osHint: Detected from the computer; change it only if it does not match

http.help: This device connects to the hub by itself; SSH is not needed.

pairing.title: Pairing requests
pairing.intro: These devices ask to connect to the hub. Accept only the ones you recognise.
pairing.dirtyWarn: You have unsaved changes on this screen. If you accept, the device list will not reload until you save or discard them.
pairing.check: Check that the code {code} is the one your device shows before accepting.

existing.http: A device with that name already exists: it will be reused and its key will be regenerated.
existing.other: A device with that name exists and is not http: it cannot be accepted; you can only reject.

pairing.accepted: “{name}” paired. It now appears in the device list and will receive its key by itself.
pairing.acceptedDirty: “{name}” paired, but you have unsaved changes and the list was not reloaded. Save or discard your changes to see the device (if saving says the configuration changed, reload and redo your changes).
pairing.gone: The request no longer exists: it expired or was withdrawn. The list was updated.
pairing.notPending: The request was already resolved (accepted, rejected or expired). The list was updated.
pairing.configChanged: The configuration changed while accepting. Press Accept again to retry.
pairing.failAccept: The request could not be accepted. Try again.
pairing.failReject: The request could not be rejected. Try again.

deck.title: Steam Deck plugin
deck.intro: Download the Decky Loader plugin and install it on the Deck (Decky settings > Developer > Install plugin from ZIP, or Install plugin from URL: <hub>/api/deck/plugin).
deck.failed: Could not fetch the plugin info. Reload the page to try again.
deck.missing: This hub does not include the plugin: the Docker image ships it packaged; in native mode, build the zip with “pnpm run zip” in checkpoint-deck/.

steam.title: Steam suggestions
steam.intro: The Steam Deck found Steam games that might belong to your library, but it is not certain. Accept only the ones that are the same game. Games with exactly the same name are linked automatically and do not show up here.
steam.dirtyWarn: You have unsaved changes on this screen. If you accept, they will not be reloaded until you save or discard them.
steam.check: Is “{steam}” on Steam the same game as “{game}”? If you accept, that game will keep the Steam id on all its devices.
steam.dismissedIntro: You discarded these suggestions and they will not be offered again. Forget a discard if you want it offered again.
steam.acceptedDirty: “{game}” now has its Steam id ({appid}), but you have unsaved changes and the screen was not reloaded. Save or discard your changes to see it (if saving says the configuration changed, reload and repeat your changes).
steam.dismissedNow: Suggestion for “{game}” discarded. It will not be offered again.
steam.forgotten: Discard for “{game}” forgotten: it can be offered again when the Deck sends its list.
steam.gone: The suggestion no longer exists: it expired or was withdrawn. The list was refreshed.
steam.gameGone: The proposed game is no longer in the configuration. The list was refreshed.
steam.gameHasAppid: That game already has a Steam id, so nothing was changed. The list was refreshed.
steam.appidInUse: Another game already uses that Steam id, so nothing was changed. The list was refreshed.
steam.configChanged: The configuration changed while accepting. Press Accept again to retry.
steam.dismissedGone: That discard no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
steam.failAccept: The suggestion could not be accepted. Try again.
steam.failDismiss: The suggestion could not be discarded. Try again.
steam.failForget: The discard could not be forgotten. Try again.

devkey.title: Device key
devkey.hint: The device identifies itself to the hub with this key. It only works for this device.
devkey.copyFail: The key could not be copied. Press Show and copy it by hand.
devkey.lockNew: Save the configuration first: the key can only be managed on devices that are already saved.
devkey.lockDirty: This card has unsaved changes. Save or discard them to manage the key.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the key
regenerate.text: The previous key will stop working and you will need to enter the new one on the device again.

revoke.title: Revoke the key
revoke.text: The device will not be able to connect to the hub until it has a new key. You can generate one whenever you want.

draft.nameHint: Up to {max} characters. Spaces, symbols, accents and emoji are allowed; no / or \
draft.versionsHint: 0 = no limit; when exceeded, the oldest are deleted

idnote.keeps: The internal ID does not change: your saves and versions stay linked.
idnote.title: Internal identifier: it does not change when renaming
idnote.label: Internal ID:

none.title: No changes
none.text: There are no differences from the current config.yaml.

save.invalid: The configuration is no longer valid: check the highlighted fields.
save.title: Review changes
save.staleText: The file was modified since you loaded it. Below are the differences between your draft and the current version: anything missing from your draft will be removed. You can confirm anyway or reload and discard your changes.

yaml.title: YAML (read-only)
yaml.invalid: The draft has errors: fix them to see the YAML.
yaml.label: Resulting YAML

backups.title: Restore earlier version
backups.stale: config.yaml was changed externally in the meantime: close, reload and try again.

none.title: No backups
none.text: A backup is made each time you save (maximum 10).

backups.prompt: Restoring {when} would change the current config.yaml like this (the current one is also kept in the backups):
backups.dirty: You have unsaved changes in the draft: they will be discarded.

autosync.title: Automatic sync
autosync.intro: Syncs all games at regular intervals. If a sync is already running, that cycle is skipped.
autosync.range: Enter a number between {min} and {max} hours.
autosync.runOnStart: Also run when the application starts

help.skip: Skip: nothing is saved and the game is marked “Conflict” so you can resolve it by hand. This is the safe option.
help.newest: Newest wins: the save with the newest date is applied and the other is kept in versions. If the dates differ by less than 2 s, it is skipped.

none.title: No runs
none.text: No automatic sync has run yet. Runs will appear here.

autostart.title: Start at sign-in
autostart.text: Creates a Windows Scheduled Task that starts Checkpoint when you sign in on this computer. It runs as your user.
autostart.savedOn: Enabled: Checkpoint will start at sign-in.
autostart.savedOff: Disabled. This does not stop the Checkpoint that is already running.

dialog.preWarn: This is a pre-release from the testing channel: it may fail.
dialog.noNotes: This version has no release notes.
dialog.manual: Checkpoint does not update itself: download the new version, rebuild the web app and restart Checkpoint.

install.confirm: Checkpoint will download version {version}, close and reopen in a few seconds.
install.restarting: Restarting… This page will reload by itself.
install.timeout: The update could not be completed. Close Checkpoint and run the downloaded installer manually.
install.windowsNote: It updates from here; your data and settings are kept.

check.title: Check for updates
check.text: Looks up the versions published on GitHub (read-only, every few hours) and notifies you if there is a new one. It installs nothing.
check.textWindows: Looks up the versions published on GitHub (every few hours) and notifies you if there is a new one. You can install it with one click.
check.limited: You just checked; wait a minute before checking again.

channel.help: Stable: only versions published as final. Testing: also includes pre-release versions, which may fail.

summary.disabled: Checking is disabled: no requests are made to the internet.
summary.newerPre: A new pre-release version is available: {latest} (installed: {current}).
summary.noData: Installed version: {current}. There is no data on the latest version yet.

keyhelp.intro: Copy it and add it to authorized_keys on each device. Press ? to see the steps.
keyhelp.infoAria: Info: steps to register the key
keyhelp.lead: Checkpoint uses its own SSH key to log in, without a password, to each device and copy its saved games. The public part must be registered on each device.

s1.title: Copy the key
s1.text: Press {copy} under the public key box. It is Checkpoint's key: you do not need to generate one on your PC.

s2.title: Paste it on the remote device
s2.hint: On each device Checkpoint connects to. Choose its system.

keyhelp.noKey: No key is visible yet: replace {placeholder} with the copied key.
keyhelp.oneLine: In authorized_keys the key takes a single line, looking like this:
keyhelp.windowsNote: Keep the default shell (cmd.exe) and use a local user.

s3.title: Check the connection
s3.text: On the device card, press {test}. It should answer {ok}. The first time, it saves the device's fingerprint.

keyhelp.warn: Paste only the public key (one line starting with ssh-ed25519). NEVER a private key.
keyhelp.inOrder: Run them in order, one at a time.
keyhelp.pickOne: Pick only one of the options, depending on the firewall you use.

winUser.title: Paste the key (regular user)
winUser.hint: In PowerShell, as the user Checkpoint will connect with.

winAdmin.title: Paste the key (administrator user)
winAdmin.hint: If that user is an administrator, the key goes in a different file. PowerShell as administrator.

archInstall.title: Install and enable the SSH server
archInstall.hint: In a terminal. The service is called sshd.

archFirewall.title: Open port 22 (only if there is a firewall)
archFirewall.hint: Arch has no firewall enabled by default. Use whichever you have.

linuxKey.title: Paste the key into authorized_keys
linuxKey.hint: As the user Checkpoint will connect with (no sudo).

debInstall.title: Install and enable the SSH server
debInstall.hint: In a terminal. The service is called ssh.

debFirewall.title: Open port 22 (only if ufw is active)
debFirewall.hint: Check first with sudo ufw status.

autostart.not_supported: Starting at sign-in is only available on Windows.

hook.device_unknown: the device does not belong to this game
hook.device_not_http: this device is not http: the hub contacts it over SSH or it is “This computer”

hook.manifest_path_invalid: the manifest has an invalid path (absolute, with .. or with disallowed characters)
hook.manifest_sha_invalid: the manifest has a sha256 that is not 64 hexadecimal characters
hook.manifest_invalid: the manifest has missing fields or fields of the wrong type
hook.manifest_too_large: the manifest exceeds the maximum of {max} files
hook.file_too_large: the file exceeds the maximum of {max_mb} MiB per file
hook.staging_full: the upload staging area of this game exceeds the maximum of {max_mb} MiB

hook.upload_size_mismatch: the file has more bytes than the declared size

hook.hub_changed: the hub changed since the comparison: compare the saves again
hook.commit_rejected: the upload is not applied: the hub must not be overwritten ({reason}); nothing is touched
hook.upload_incomplete: {missing} files are still to be uploaded: {paths}

hook.range_invalid: invalid Range header or outside the file

deck.plugin_missing: the Steam Deck plugin is not included in this hub

config.name_slash: invalid name: / and \ are not allowed

config.name_dots: invalid name: it cannot be only dots
config.id_invalid: invalid internal id: 1 to 64 characters from letters, numbers, _ and -
